info.title: Oryn Control Plane, Synchronization, and Transient Inference API
info.description: Normative OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification for Oryn Control Plane HTTP/WebSocket transport, BFF session lifecycle, durable operation tracking, management change polling, contribution synchronization, and transient inference admission.

post.summary: Initiate confidential BFF Web login or step-up
post.description: Initiates Auth0 OIDC PKCE flow, sets __Host-oryn_login transaction cookie, returns Auth0 authorization URL.

200.description: Login transaction created; redirect to Auth0

400.description: Invalid login request or return path

get.description: Redeems authorization code against Auth0, establishes session, sets __Host-oryn_session cookie.

302.description: Redirects to validated return_path on public origin with session cookie set.

400.description: Invalid state, nonce, or code redemption failure

get.summary: Retrieve active web BFF session presentation

200.description: Current web session presentation and active CSRF token

post.summary: Record human interaction heartbeat
Switch active organization scope

200.description: Organization scope updated with refreshed session credentials or web presentation

403.description: Membership inactive or organization access denied

post.summary: Terminate current session and revoke credential family
Request operation cancellation
Obtain initial sync control epoch and guidance cursor
Ingest employee-reviewed contribution package (Contract 2)

200.description: Identical replay of existing contribution or pruned status

get.summary: Query submission custody status and delivery receipt

post.summary: Record voluntary withdrawal of contribution custody
Obtain offline guidance access lease
Request cryptographic challenge for review key enrollment
Register employee device review public key
Admit transient inference request and reserve budget (Contract 22)

201.description: Inference authorization grant and ephemeral session handle

403.description: Policy rejection, stale revision, or uncertified route

429.description: Budget limit or concurrency ceiling exceeded

post.summary: Synchronous single-shot inference dispatch

get.summary: WebSocket upgrade for real-time audio and inference streaming

post.summary: Renew authorization quantum for active stream
Idempotent cancellation of inference request or active stream

get.summary: Query certified route availability and limits

get.description: Returns cursor-paginated candidates filtered by caller's authorized audience, team, and state.

post.summary: Create explicit manual workflow candidate draft
post.description: Owner or delegated author creates manual candidate draft with explicit team and audience.

403.description: Unauthorized to create candidate for team

get.description: Fetches candidate header and current revision, revalidating caller audience against contributing sources.

403.description: Access denied by source audience conjunction

get.description: Fetches immutable historical candidate revision. Source content is revalidated; invalidated payloads report status without replaying purged text.

get.summary: Get bounded section of candidate revision
get.description: Retrieves large candidate sections (procedure, evidence, questions, history) partitioned under standard 256 KiB response caps.

post.summary: Begin review or request evidence on candidate
Apply reviewer edits to candidate procedure
post.description: Applies full replacement of the editable procedure subset under optimistic concurrency.

post.summary: Accept or decline proposed evidence diff
Submit answer to clarification question
Approve candidate and stage for guidance publication
post.description: Validates owner remit, gates, and source fence, then stages candidate into Operational Graph.

409.description: Approval gates failed or revision conflict

post.summary: Reject candidate and activate suppression rule

200.description: Candidate rejected and suppression rule active

post.summary: Owner decision on suppression reconsideration request
Split candidate into multiple narrower drafts
Merge multiple candidates into single unified draft
Trigger authorized re-synthesis from pinned manifest
Owner retirement of active suppression rule
Extend candidate retention under explicit policy grant
Record evidenced outcome assessment for demonstration

409.description: Conflicting evidence or attempt not found

get.description: Returns aggregate opportunity metrics subject to cohort privacy suppression. No per-employee filters or grouping keys exposed.

put.summary: Set owner-supplied assumptions for financial projection

put.description: Requires security_policy.manage and an authorized routing team.

post.summary: Publish staged candidate into canonical company playbook
post.description: Operational Graph-owned publication boundary. Revalidates eligibility, rules, and staged content hash before emitting workflow.published.

409.description: Staged revision mismatch or source invalidated
